name: Oslo National Academy of the Arts (KHiO)
summary: Oslo’s national arts academy; its one bachelor’s open in English is Classical Ballet, run in close cooperation with the Norwegian National Ballet.

ib.text: Ballet admission rests on the audition; the IB Diploma meets the general entry requirement. KHiO's other bachelor's are taught in Norwegian and need Norwegian proficiency.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Programme in Classical Ballet
programmes.ib: Audition-based; finalists at Prix de Lausanne or Youth America Grand Prix can also qualify. 2026 deadline was 27 February; 2027 dates not yet published.

notes: Teaching is in Norwegian and English, with special arrangements for English-speaking students; non-Norwegian speakers must be fluent in English.
The ballet programme is open to dancers aged 15 or over who have finished lower secondary school, not only to school leavers.
KHiO opens Søknadsweb and posts the year's audition details about two months before the deadline.
